name: hippus_worker
description: a Hippus Worker (Fall from Heaven), a bearded, dark-haired labourer: a tall peaked brown hat with a thick cream fur brim, a white shirt with rolled sleeves and bare forearms, an orange vest, a red sash, brown trousers and brown boots, and a long wooden hoe with a grey iron blade, gripped by the end of its handle in his RIGHT hand
hands: the hoe's handle end stays in his right hand on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the handle lower down, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the handle, the hoe is raised above the head with its handle held across the top of the fur hat and the iron blade out past the hat on the right
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the hoe hand behind the head and the hoe handle hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the iron blade at its lower end, the left hand an empty fist tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the hoe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the hoe handle is level, its iron blade at the far end pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: hoe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the iron blade of the hoe chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the hoe carries on down until its iron blade nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the peaked fur hat tilting, the empty left fist trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the hoe comes back toward its resting angle, held low in front with the iron blade near the ground at the lower-right, the left hand reaching for the handle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the hoe hand thrown out to the left with the hoe handle swung level across the chest, the empty left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the hoe held across the body with its blade end tilted up to the right, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, hoe arm flung up with the hoe slanting down across the body, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the hoe lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the iron blade of the hoe resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the hoe slips out of the hand, the peaked fur hat tipping, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the peaked fur hat still on his head; the hoe lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the fur hat stays on
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the hoe on the ground beside him
